name: Spectral Multiple Importance Sampling
aliases: Spectral Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) for Wavelengths
Spectral Multiple Importance Sampling for Wavelengths
definition: Problem: Spectrally varying medium properties cause variance when a single sampling PDF (based on one wavelength) is used to evaluate a function at multiple wavelengths, as the PDF may be a poor match or invalid (zero-valued) for other wavelengths.
summary: Spectral Multiple Importance Sampling reduces variance in spectrally varying media by sampling wavelengths based on throughput and albedo, then applying MIS weights to balance contributions across all channels.
